IT Services & Consulting.econ: Fear that AI agents/coding tools shrink billable hours. Accenture cut FY26 growth to 3-4% (Jun-26, record drop); Infosys 5-yr low.
IT Services & Consulting.fund: Revenue still +6% y/y, margins above 5y avg: the hit is in the multiple, not yet in the P&L.

Packaged Foods.econ: Volume declines: private-label trade-down, heavy promotions, GLP-1 drag (~-0.2%/yr), cocoa/input costs. GIS cut FY26 outlook.
Packaged Foods.fund: Median op margin 8.7% vs 11.5% 5y avg; revenue flat. Real fundamental erosion.

Managed Care.econ: Medical-cost trend spike 2024-26 + tight Medicare Advantage rates (2027 final +2.48%) + Medicaid trough year.
Managed Care.fund: Margins 2.7% vs 3.6% 5y; plans reprice yearly. Stocks already +22% vs SPY over 1y.

Beverages.econ: 2023-25 de-rating on soft volumes, aluminum/tariff costs, GLP-1 fears. Price-led growth slowing.

Payment Networks & Processors.econ: Stablecoin + agentic-commerce 'bypass the card rails' fear (Feb-26 scenario report); legacy processors (FIS/GPN/Fiserv) losing to modern stacks.
Payment Networks & Processors.fund: Median revenue +15% y/y; networks' margins intact.

Telecom & Cable.econ: Cable keeps losing broadband subs to fixed-wireless + fiber; ACP subsidy ended. Wireless steady.
Telecom & Cable.fund: Revenue +4%, margins OK; cable volume decline is the long-term risk.

Household & Personal Products.econ: 2023-25 slump on input costs and volumes; trade-down to private label. Recovering in 2026 (+8% vs SPY 1y).

Oilfield Services.econ: N. American shale activity fell 2023-25 (capital discipline). Middle East disruption now lifting international/offshore work.
Oilfield Services.fund: Margins above 5y avg; revenue flat. Classic capex cycle.

Chemicals & Industrial Gases.econ: Commodity-chem downturn: China builds ~70% of new capacity through 2027; DOW and LYB halved dividends. Gases/coatings fine.

Restaurants.econ: Low-income traffic down (MCD visits -4.5% Q2-26); gas + food inflation; value-menu price war.

Insurance Brokers.econ: Soft P&C pricing slows organic growth (BRO ~0% 9M-26) + AI disintermediation fear.
Insurance Brokers.fund: Revenue +9%, margins in line with 5y avg.

Homebuilders.econ: 30y mortgage ~7%, Fed hiking into an oil shock, incentives 10-12% of price, builder sentiment lowest since 2012.
Homebuilders.fund: Revenue -5.5%, margins 12.8% vs 16.2% 5y. Land is the capital need.

Medical Devices.econ: Tariffs (Sec. 232 probe), China volume-based procurement, GLP-1 'fewer procedures' fear.

Exploration & Production.econ: Pure E&Ps are price-takers with no refining windfall; margins off the 2022 peak; lagged the AI-led market 3 years.
Exploration & Production.fund: Revenue +24% on the oil spike; margins 19% vs 30% 5y (2022 peak in base).

Asset Managers & Alternatives.econ: Private-credit stress: redemption gates, record default rate; plus long-running active-to-passive outflows.

Autos & EVs.econ: EV write-downs (Ford ~$19.5B), tariff costs ($2.5-3.5B GM 2026), EV credits gone, demand cut.

Trucking, Parcel & Logistics.econ: Three-year freight recession (2023-25) and Amazon insourcing at parcel; volumes recovering in 2026.
Trucking, Parcel & Logistics.fund: Revenue +9%, margins near 5y avg; +16% vs SPY 1y.

Life Science Tools & Diagnostics.econ: Post-COVID destocking, 2025 NIH/academic funding cuts, China weakness, biotech funding drought.

Specialty & Home Improvement Retail.econ: Frozen housing turnover (7% mortgages) hits home-improvement big tickets; tariffs on imported goods.
